Next.js TypeScript App Router: `src/app`, `src/app/api/*`, `src/components`, `src/hooks`, `src/lib`; assets `public/`; scripts `scripts/`; Vite `vite-base-template/`.

`npm run dev`; `npm run build`; `npm run start`; `npm run lint`; `cd vite-base-template && npm run dev`; `npm --prefix vite-base-template run build`.

PRs must include:
Summary of changes and rationale.
Steps to test locally; attach screenshots for UI changes.
Linked issue(s) and checklist: builds, lints, and runs locally.
Environment: use `.env.local` for developer machines; do not commit secrets.
